This page groups words containing a vav-ḥolam-alef sequence, with the labels dividing the examples into a few recurring subpatterns and a miscellaneous remainder.

The short labels are bucket names within this FOI search, not separate grammatical categories. In particular, a-misc is the residual bucket after the more specific named patterns are excluded.
